#
# The signify public keys that verify a signed release. scripts/deps
# reads this file for the signify tier, and it reads deps/KEYS.local.txt
# after it. A consumer pins a third-party key in the local file, which
# sync never touches.
#
# A line holds a name and then one of two forms:
#
#   <name> <key-body>
#   <name> <url> <sha256>
#
# The body form gives the 56 base64 characters of the key body. The URL
# form gives the published key file and its sha256 digest, and the
# digest is the trust anchor. The line order is the trust order, so the
# current key comes first.
fugubsd-1-release https://www.fugubsd.org/keys/fugubsd-1-release.pub 08ee701466c3a9b698bda9d72f59fbc7d83b549eeb672290a3a41ca7b6bc8c0f
